title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was October's biggest game in the US, but it wasn't enough to crack 2026's best-selling top 10
summary: Despite its somewhat muted critical reception, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has predictably topped the US video game charts in October. The Infinity Ward -developed shooter was October's best-selling game in the US across digital and retail, beating the month's other big-hitters, including Gears of War: E-Day and Star Wars: Galactic Racer. Read more

title: Infamous GTA 6 leaker CyberLeek is back, and this time the group claims to have leaked a full development build of the game
summary: CyberLeek, the persona of a hacker group that was responsible for leaking GTA 6 gameplay before the game launched, has reappeared today, claiming to have released a development build of the final version of the game on its site. This new leak appears to be making good on a threat posted back in October, where the group stated its intent to release a full, playable build of the game . Read more

title: GTA 6 has replaced websites with social media and phone apps because "it didn't feel necessary"
summary: The internet of today is a far cry from the days when Grand Theft Auto 5 was released, which is partly why Rockstar didn't bring back its own satirical version of the web in GTA 6 . Read more

title: After Grand Theft Auto 6's launch, players are in love with wacky criminality, in-game social media, and animal fatalities
summary: With Grand Theft Auto 6 launching late last night ( unless you're in New Zealand, in-person or otherwise ), players have been flocking to online spaces to share their favourite moments. So far, slapstick violence, animal fatalities, and the in-game social media have won the hearts of many. Read more

title: GameStop CEO slams 'code-in-a-box' games in the wake of GTA 6's discless release
summary: Ryan Cohen, CEO of GameStop - the self-proclaimed "world's largest retail gaming and trade-in destination" - is not happy with the emerging trend of games releasing without discs. Per the CEO, the industry's move away from physical games and towards a digital-only future is harmful to both consumers and businesses. Read more

title: Does GTA 6 have an 'easy mode'? Not officially, but there are two very important settings you can change to make the game less difficult
summary: By now, you've probably heard that you cannot use cheats in GTA 6 until you complete the main story . Not only that, but enabling cheat codes also locks story progression and deactivates the ability to save. Basically, you can use cheats to have a quick crime spree and blow off some steam, then it's back to normalcy. Understandably, some gamers are a little put out with this change. Read more

title: Rockstar reveals full GTA 6 cast list, finally ending speculation about who plays Jason Duval in the game
summary: UPDATE 5PM GMT: Actors Manni L. Perez and Dylan Rourke have announced their involvement in GTA 6 , in portraying Lucia and Jason, respectively, in the game. Read more

title: Grand Theft Auto 6 launch day - all the news and rection as GTA 6 arrived around the world
summary: The day is finally here: Grand Theft Auto 6 is available to play worldwide. It's destined to become the largest video game release of all time, and probably one of the biggest entertainment releases of all time. So we're doing a launch day live blog to chart its arrival in the world. Read more

title: Over 2 million Xbox players in the UK and US reportedly used the 'New Zealand trick' to play GTA 6 early - that's more than a third of the country's population
summary: We already knew there'd be a frantic clamour for GTA 6 this week, and we also knew plenty of players would be eyeing up Xbox's 'New Zealand trick' to get in on the action early. But it's now being reported that a whopping 2m UK and US players took advantage of the trick - which, for context, equals more than a third of New Zealand's actual population. Read more

title: GTA 6 developers at Rockstar are worried about being laid off after shipping "the biggest game of all time"
summary: Rockstar has successfully shipped Grand Theft Auto 6 , after years of work and more than a billion dollars spent. GTA 6 is already one of the highest-rated games ever - Eurogamer awarded it five stars in our GTA 6 review - and it's expected to be among the most successful, best-selling games ever . Read more

title: As Rockstar's alleged "union busting" tribunal hearing comes to a close amid GTA 6 launch, judge pledges to deliver verdict "as quickly as I possibly can"
summary: Closing statements in Rockstar and IWGB's employment tribunal case - revolving around the GTA 6 developer's alleged 'union busting' and the firing of 34 employees - have now been read, bringing the hearing to an end. There's currently no timeline for a verdict, however, with one commentator suggesting a judgement could take weeks or months to arrive. Read more

title: GTA 6 players are being abducted by aliens and knocked out by Bigfoot
summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has only been out for a matter of hours, and players have already tracked down a UFO in the woods and a Bigfoot in the swamps. Read more

title: Warren Spector lambasts GTA 6's "billion dollar" development - 'I just hope it's is the last of its kind even if it's the best we have to offer'
summary: As GTA 6 finally arrives, increasingly outspoken games industry legend Warren Spector - known for seminal immersive sims including Deus Ex - has offered both praise for the game's achievements and lambasted its "billion dollar" development model, writing, "I just hope GTA 6 is the last of its kind even if it’s the best we have to offer". Read more

title: Ubisoft says Assassin's Creed Jade is still alive as it merges two of its Creative Houses
summary: Ubisoft has confirmed that while Assassin's Creed Jade - its mobile entry in the series - is still in development, its focus remains with console and PC. Read more

title: Ubisoft cuts jobs at major Assassin's Creed and Far Cry studios as its year of layoffs continues
summary: Ubisoft has confirmed more layoffs as part of its previously announced operational "reset", this time affecting 166 employees at its major Montréal and Québec City studios - the teams responsible for game series including Assassin's Creed and Far Cry. It says the cuts are necessary "to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs." Read more

title: The hunt for World of Warcraft: Forever secrets continue with the discovery of an elusive pet
summary: The search for secrets in World of Warcraft: Forever continues ever onwards, with a new breakthrough coming to light in recent days. The latest discovery? An elusive new cat that can be tamed by hunters in one of the game's new zones. Read more

title: World of Warcraft: Forever has more weekly players than WoW has seen in 15 years, says Blizzard
